name: botgo
description: BotGo 科技品牌官网首页

scripts.pretest: node --experimental-sqlite tests/conversations.test.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite tests/metering.test.mjs && node --experimental-sqlite tests/release-bootstrap.test.mjs
scripts.precheck: node --check worker/src/conversations.js && node --check ui-kit.js && node --check admin-metering.js && node --check worker/src/metering.js && node --check scripts/probe-models.mjs && node --check tests/ui-preview.cjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/homepage-workspace.test.mjs && node tests/codex-setup.test.mjs && node tests/gpt56-release.test.mjs && node tests/upstream-theme-contract.test.mjs && node tests/platform-management.test.mjs && node tests/alipay-payment.test.mjs && node tests/dev-preview.test.mjs && node tests/admin.test.mjs && node tests/cinematic-layout.test.mjs && node tests/home-hero-split.test.mjs && npm run test:desktop && node tests/agent-releases.test.mjs && npm --prefix agent test
scripts.test:desktop: node tests/desktop-auth.test.mjs && node tests/desktop-web-authorization.test.mjs && node tests/desktop-web-auth.test.cjs && node tests/desktop-runtime.test.cjs && node tests/desktop-ui-contract.test.cjs
scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check workspace.js && node --check workspace-billing.js && node --check scripts/dev.mjs && node --check functions/api/[[path]].js && node --check worker/src/index.js && node --check worker/src/platform-admin.js && node --check worker/src/alipay-crypto.js && node --check worker/src/alipay-payment.js && node --check worker/src/alipay-routes.js && npm run check:desktop && node scripts/build.mjs --check && node --check worker/src/agent-releases.js && node --check agent-install.js && npm --prefix agent run check
scripts.check:desktop: node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/preload.cjs && node --check desktop/renderer.js && node --check desktop/lib/local-state.cjs && node --check desktop/lib/credential-store.cjs && node --check desktop/lib/codex-config.cjs && node --check desktop/lib/web-auth.cjs
scripts.migrate:worker: npx --yes wrangler@4.125.0 d1 migrations apply botgo --remote --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:pages: npx --yes wrangler@4.125.0 pages deploy dist --project-name botgo --branch main
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run migrate:worker && npm run deploy:worker && npm run deploy:pages
